title: Minimum Difference Between Largest And Smallest Value In Three Moves
description: Minimize the difference between the maximum and minimum values of an array after performing at most three moves (changing any element to any value).
pseudocode:
1. sort(nums)
2. if n <= 4 return 0
3. min_diff = infinity
4. for i from 0 to 3:
5.   diff = nums[n - 4 + i] - nums[i]
6.   min_diff = min(min_diff, diff)
7. return min_diff

steps.note: Starting loop: i = 0. Comparing smallest and 4th largest.
Calculating diff: nums[5-4+0] - nums[0] = nums[1] - nums[0] = 1 - 0 = 1
Next loop: i = 1. Removing 1 smallest and 2 largest.
Calculating diff: nums[5-4+1] - nums[1] = nums[2] - nums[1] = 5 - 1 = 4
Calculating diff: nums[5-4+2] - nums[2] = nums[3] - nums[2] = 10 - 5 = 5
Calculating diff: nums[5-4+3] - nums[3] = nums[4] - nums[3] = 14 - 10 = 4
